name: hopelessness
quote: There's no way she's going to be ok.
description: Sadness from a sense that a particular desired outcome is so unlikely as to be impossible.

variations.name: material hopelessness
variations.description: Sadness from a sense that a material gain of money or something else desired is impossible.

variations.name: social hopelessness
variations.description: Sadness from a sense that a social reward is essentially impossible.

variations.name: existential hope
variations.description: Sadness from a sense that it's still possible to achieve your ideal self.

commentaries.quote: Hopelessness is a really toxic and dangerous state.
Hopelessness is a feeling. It's not a fact.
If you're feeling chronically hopeless or depressed, you should seek counseling.

It may be worth examining the threshold for what you view as 'unlikely'. If your chance of getting that reward 20%? 2%? Or is it really zero? Do you identify as the kind of person who's going to give up when there's still a non-zero chance?
Hopelessness is felt deeply as a stormy sea, while pessimism floats on more mild waters.

conditions: Sadness from a sense that a particular desired outcome is so unlikely as to be impossible.
